2.88.18
Chart.ChartTitles
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.ChartTitles element specifies the collection of chart titles in a Chart. This element is
optional. This element is of type ChartTitles.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ChartTitles element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ChartTitles element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartTitles" type="ChartTitlesType" minOccurs="0" />
